title: Wedderburn decomposition of Twisted skew abelian group algebra
summary: We compute the Wedderburn decomposition of a finite twisted skew group algebra over a finite abelian group $G$ and a finite field $K$. To do so, we prove that this twisted skew group algebra is a homomorphic image of a finite group algebra. We then characterise its Shoda pairs, as well as propose an algorithm for computing a complete set of them.
